title: Don't push that door
persona: Pan-India observer, late 20s, close-mic, slight smile, no shout. Not the player.
mic_note: One hand from the mic. Land the Hindi connectors at the same volume as the English. Leave the gap before the end card.

cues.performance: [close, slight smile] Yeh push nahi bachega.
cues.mix_note: Under the door break. Do not wait for it to finish.

cues.spoken: The team bol rahi hai wait, lekin yeh banda still takes the door.
cues.performance: [deadpan on the second clause] The team bol rahi hai wait, lekin yeh banda still takes the door.

cues.spoken: Loot girta hai aur the call is simple: airdrop, ya zone?
cues.performance: [lean in, not louder] Loot girta hai aur the call is simple: airdrop, ya zone?
cues.mix_note: Stop and let the two icons sit. The pause is the decision.

cues.spoken: A third party walks in from behind. Jo abhi hero ban raha tha, ab sirf bachna hai.
cues.performance: [drop the pace after the full stop] A third party walks in from behind. Jo abhi hero ban raha tha, ab sirf bachna hai.
cues.mix_note: Duck the bed. Leave the footstep sting dry before this line ends.

cues.performance: [close, no smile] Akela mat push karna.
cues.mix_note: Finish before the card. Do not read the card.

intentional_silence.reason: End card reads DON'T PUSH ALONE. The viewer reads it. The voice does not.
